Health Work AI is at the cutting edge of applying artificial intelligence to transform the healthcare industry. Our commitment to innovation and excellence has positioned us as leaders in health technology. job_title: Improve AI Model for Real-Time Call Center Predictions - Contract to Hire
job_description:
KomBea is seeking an experienced AI engineer or expert to improve our existing AI model that makes real-time predictions during live customer service calls. This is a classification problem to predict the appropriate key sequence the agent should press based on the current conversation context.

Our current RNN model achieves around 80% accuracy. The goal of this project is to increase the model's accuracy to over 90% by exploring different modeling approaches. The model must be small enough to run locally on the agent's Windows machine with very low latency (less than 150 ms per prediction) as it will be queried at every conversation turn.

We have tens of thousands of historical call records, both tagged by our labeling team and structured but untagged but with GPT-generated suggestions, that can be used for model training and validation.

The input features at each conversation turn include:

•Transcription (str): The actual transcription text

• Transcription confidence (float): Confidence score of the transcription

• Transcription finished (bool): Flag if the person has finished speaking

• Page (str): Current page/section in the call flow script

• Process (str): Identifier for the specific call process

• Version (int): Version number of the call process

The model should output:

• Key (str): 1-3 character key sequence to execute the appropriate action

• Confidence (float): Confidence score of the key prediction

While additional caller metadata is available, it is not currently utilized in the model. However, we are open to including it if it demonstrably improves performance.

The project will be implemented in Python using pandas and standard ML libraries. We prefer TensorFlow 2 but are open to other frameworks. It should be delivered as well-documented code in Jupyter notebook format clearly explaining architectural choices and experiments.

We will evaluate models based on their F1 score on a held-out test set. The initial deliverable should be available within 2 weeks of project kickoff, after which we expect to iterate and refine the model over the following weeks.

This will begin as a fixed-scope project but we anticipate ongoing collaboration with successful candidates and potential conversion to full-time for the right person. Please include in your proposal your relevant experience, a high-level overview of your modeling approach, your proposed timeline and availability, and your bid for the initial phase. We prefer experts in this domain but will consider all strong candidates.
